(ja)༄༅/ /rten khrus ri khrus sogs kyi cho ga nyes pa kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /gu ru pā da bh+yun+namaḥ'adir rten khrus ri khrus sogs

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rten khrus ri khrus sogs kyi cho ga nyes pa kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gu ru pā da bh+yun+namaḥ 'dir rten khrus ri khrus sogs kyi lag len cung zad spro bar bya ste/ de yang sngon du dme brtsegs rnam 'joms gang rung gi bum pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin byas la/ slar yang 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gzungs chu sgrub pa bcas nyis sbrags byung na shin tu legs la/ skabs 'gar de tsam long med par glo bur du sgrub dgos shar na/ bum pa gtsang ma chus bkang bar/ dri bzang po'i sman spos kyi rigs sbyar zhing*/ bum chu rnying pa'i gta' yod na sbags/ kha rgyan mgul chings bcas spyi ltar dang*/ gzungs thag gdags/ rang yi dam gang yin gyi nga rgyal dran tsam gyi ngang nas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzungs sngags rnams kyi phreng ba kha dog dkar po g.yas skor du 'khod pa la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song ba phog pas de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la gzungs thag nas bzung ste rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ ram̐ ho am̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ a shu mam̐ bi shud+dhe shud+dhe/ shud+dhe sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes mi g.yo ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba dang*/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bi ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ a hi ram̐ bi na ram̐ shud+dhe ram̐ a a swā hā/ oṃ bi rasti bi rasti swā hā/

zhes gzungs 'dus nas 'byung ba dang*/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe a a swā hā/ zhes gsar rnying gi las tshogs mtha' dag nas go rim cung zad mi 'dra bar 'byung mod/ phal cher 'di bzhin yod pa shas che ba yin/ de rnams so so nas lan nyer gcig tsam re'am klu dang sa bdag sogs snad tshabs che na seng ge'i sgra'i gdon dgrol nas 'byung ba'i oṃ ru ru s+phu ru sogs yum gnyis kyi sngags gang mang bzlas pa'i mthar/ gzungs thag bsdus la/ sngags phreng gdan dang bcas pa zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces brjod/ rten khrus yin na rten gyi drung du/ sbyong chas rnams bshams la/ ting lo sbar la gtor mar chab kyis bran/ mchod g.yog pas dbus g.yas g.yon gyi rim pas blangs te/ g.yas su bskor zhing rang gis mchog sbyin dang bcas/ oṃ sarba bigh+na na maḥsarba sogs lan gsum/ ting lo dang changs bu bskor zhing*/ rdo rje gsor te/ oṃ suṃ bha sogs lan gsum/ rnam 'joms yin na de'i tshab yang snying brjod/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la khrus kyis mnga' gsol ba la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i zhes sam/ brtan bzhugs dang 'brel na/ rab tu gnas par byed pa la zhes brjod kyang chog gang ltar yang*/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma lam brngan sogs spyi ltar dang*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa sogs kyis khro bo spyan 'dren mchod bstod bcas dang bden brdar lan gsum la tshig bsgyur gong gi 'gros kyis shes/ so so'i mthar drag rol dang bcas suṃ bha sogs drag sngags brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab bo// mchod g.yog pas sku phyi phrag pa g.yon la bkal/

g.yon pas khrus sder gyi thad du me long 'dzin pa la rten gyi gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug g.yas pas bum pa bzung ste sngags kyi tshe khrus gsol/ rang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ spro na rdor dbyings rab gnas nas 'byung ba'i/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o// zhes dam bca' ba dang*/ spyod 'jug nas 'byung ba'i/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher bar bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// zhes khrus kyi khang pa gsal 'debs pa ste/ 'di gnyis 'don ma thub na mos pa tsam bya'o// gang ltar yang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs oṃ sarba ta thā= 'di ni khrus mchog= oṃ sarba ta thā= 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba= 'di ni tshul khrims sogs sh+lo ka drug sngags bcas dang*/ rgyas par spro na/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku= oṃ sarba ta= zhes pas bla ma/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba= spro na/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// kye yi rdo rjer sku khrus= /oṃ sarba= chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la sku=

/oṃ sarba= zhes sogs gang dgos kyang yi dam dang*/ ston pa bla med= /oṃ sarba= thabs mkhas thugs rjes= /oṃ sarba= phyogs bcu'i 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor bas// phyogs bcu'i 'gro kun yongs su skyob mdzad pa// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la sku= oṃ sarba= mthun pa'i smon lam= oṃ sarba= smra bsam brjod med= oṃ sarba= 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje= oṃ sarba= lha dang lha min= oṃ sarba= dgra bcom blo mchog dbang po kun dul ba// bstan pa'i srid du legs par brtan bzhugs nas// bstan pa 'dzin dang skyong dang spel mdzad pa'i// gnas brtan chen po rnams la sku khrus= oṃ sarba= zab mo'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis legs bsgoms pas// rang byung rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni// bstan pa med pa'i tshul gyis thugs chud pa// 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la sku khrus= /oṃ sarba= zhes pa yan gyis dkon mchog dang spro na/ dpal ldan mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rdo rje gur// khyab bdag ston pa kye yi rdo rje yi// sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i srung ma mchog /nag po chen po khyod la sku= oṃ sarba= sogs sh+lo ka re re dang*/ thun mong du/ rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba// rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la sku khrus= oṃ sarba= rgyal chen sde bzhi phyogs skyong 'jigs byed dang*// lha klu gza' skar la sogs 'jig rten dbang*// gnod sbyin sde dpon 'phrog ma bur bcas sogs// gtsug lag khang skyong rnams la sku= oṃ sarba= byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras// nor gyi bdag po ār+ya dzaṃ bha la// dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma// nor lha gter bdag rnams la= oṃ sarba= zhes sogs kyis chos skyong nor lha dang*/

gtsug lag khang la gnyug mar gnas pa'i klu yod na/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la= oṃ sarba= khyed kyi rang bzhin yongs dag pas// srid pa'i 'ching ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang slad du// gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba= rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba= de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa dus mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba= zhes pa yan gyis khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes pas me long ngos la dri'i thig le lnga byas la/ sku phyis kyis phyi ba'i tshul bya'o// spro na/ slar yang me long gi ngos la dri bzang byug cing*/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs nas/ bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+rā ya āḥhūm̐/ gis na bza' 'bul lo// brtan bzhugs byed na/ nas la/ ye dharmā mang du brjod la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar spyi ltar lan gsum dang*/ spro na/ rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad sogs tshang ma'am/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas rten 'di la// 'gro ba'i don du mi 'bral brtan bzhugs nas// sbyin bdag dge zhing shis par mdzad du gsol// ji srid sa sogs 'byung ba chen po bzhis// sku gzugs gnod par ma gyur de srid du// thugs rje chen po mgon po bcom ldan 'das// brtan par bzhugs nas bkra shis mdzad du gsol// slar yang*/

ji snyed su dag sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa dbul zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol lo// de dag ni spros pa la dga' zhing tshogs spel ba'i don du rten khrus rgyas par bya ba'i tshul lo// khrus rkyang pa tsam byed na/ thog mar/ yungs kar ram bum chu 'thor zhing*/ suṃ bha sogs brjod pas bgegs bskrad/ ji ltar bltams pa= 'di ni khrus mchog= phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad dang= de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang sogs kyis khrus gsol/ de dag sku la sogs sngags dang bcas pas sku phyi'o// de nas brtan bzhugs dang bkra shis mdor bsdus bya ba ni bsdus pa'i lugs yin la/ de las cung zhig rgyas par 'dod na'ang rang gi rig pas 'phrul shes par bya'o// ༈ /gnyis pa ri khrus ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ sngar bzhin bsgrubs pa'i bum chus rten byin rlabs can la khrus gsol ba'i chu de slar bum par blugs la ri mtho sa'am/ khang thog tu khyer la/ sbyong ba gsum sngar bzhin la/ 'dir yul phyogs 'di dge legs su sgrub pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs/ zhes sogs tshig bsgyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams dang*/ stong gsum gyi lha ma srin sde brgyad dang*/ khyad par lung pa 'di'i phu mda' bar gsum dang nyin srib/ dkar nag gi sa rdo brag rtsi shing nags tshal/ mtsho dang chu klung sogs la bdag gir byed pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ btsan dang*/ bdud dang*/ sa bdag gnyan mthu bo che/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag la sogs pa rnams dang*/ khas zhan dbang chung ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dag byed khrus kyi mgron du ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas bkug la sa dang bar snang thams cad du khrom tshogs pa bzhin du 'khod par bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la lha mo mdog sna tshogs pa bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa dpag tu med pa sprul te de rnams kyis mgron rnams kyi spyi bo nas blugs shing khrus byas pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag

nad dang sdug bsngal dang khros pa thams cad zhi/ bying rmugs 'thibs pa sangs shing*/ bde ba dang dga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes pa'i dmigs pa rtse gcig pa dang bcas pas/ me long la ri klung kun gyi gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug pa bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya dang*/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe sogs khrus sngags 'og ma dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// zhes sogs phar phyin drug gi khrus sh+lo ka re rdzogs mtshams su sngags gong bzhin dang*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// sogs sh+lo ka gsum gyi mthar sngags dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// zhes sogs gsum dang*/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin te/ zhes sogs sh+lo ka bzhi'i mthar sngags gong bzhin sbyar/ slar yang rol mo dang bcas pas bum chu phyogs kun tu 'thor zhing rnam 'joms dme brtsegs sogs kyis bsgrubs pa yin na de dag gi gzungs sngags dang*/ min na'ang yig brgya dang khrus sngags mang du brjod do// rol mo bzhag ste/ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams dang*/ stong gsum gyi lha ma srin sde brgyad dang*/ khyad par du yul phyogs 'di'i lung pa phu mda' bar gsum/ nyin srib dkar nag gi sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing*/ nags tshal/ mtsho dang*/ chu klu sogs la gnas shing bdag gir byed pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ btsan dang*/ bdud dang*/ sa bdag gnyan mthu bo che/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag la sogs pa dang*/ khas zhan dbang chung ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad dang nyer 'tshe thams cad= sdug bsngal dang zug rngu thams cad= thab gzhob dang rdzas ngan gyis phog pa thams cad/

dme mnol mna' gsum gyis phog pa thams cad= dam nyams dang 'khon grib kyis phog pa thams cad= sa brko rdo rlogs kyis bsnan pa thams cad= shing gnyan bcad pa dang chu gnyan dkrugs pas khros pa thams cad= chos min ngan spyod kyis khros pa thams cad= ban bon mthu bo ches bcings pa thams cad= mnan pa dang gzir ba thams cad= gtad khram dang dbye chog gis phyes pa thams cad= mdor na rgud pa dang nyams pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bkru'o// bum chu dang me tog 'thor zhing*/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang zhig bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yis// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig chos rnams mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa ni rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/

thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs gyur// rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs gyur// khyed cag lam 'gro bde gyur cig /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde gyur cig /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces dang*/ mgron dkar phyogs pa rnams kyis sngon gyi dam bca' rjes su dran pa dang*/ nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba rnams kyang glo bur du sems chos la 'gyur nas gus pa dang zhi ba'i kun spyod kyis bdag gis gang bsgo ba nyan par bsams la/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// zhes pa nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes dang*/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang sogs nas/ gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /ces pa'i bar gyis chos bshad/ yul phyogs kun tu char chu dus su 'babs// lo phyugs rtag tu legs par mdzad du gsol// mi nad phyugs nad dus 'khrugs rgyun chad nas// rgyal khams bde bas 'tsho bar mdzad du= /rgyal po rnams kyang chos bzhin sa skyong zhing*// 'bangs rnams bka' bzhin sgrub par mdzad= /'gro kun phan tshun byams pa'i sems ldan zhing*// dge bcu'i chos la spyod par= /bstan dang bstan 'dzin gus pas mchod pa'i mthus// rdzogs ldan dus bzhin bde bar mdzad du gsol// ces phrin las bcol/ byang chub sems ni rin po che sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu spyod pa dang*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rnam pa kun tu mchod par shog

/'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// sogs kyis smon lam gdab bo// ston mchog dam pa sogs sh+lo ka gsum dang*/ 'byung po gang dag sogs dang*/ nyin mo bde legs sogs kyi bkra shis brjod do// de dag gis ni ri khrus su grags pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rgyas par bstan zin te/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skye bo rnams kyi bya ba chos dang khrims lugs dang 'gal ba'i rtsing spyod kho nar ngang gis 'gro bas dkar phyogs kyi lha klu rnams grib kyis phog nas dbu 'phang dma'/ nag phyogs rnams zhe sdang gis khros nas 'jig rten du mi bde ba sha stag 'byung bas gang zag gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam dang ldan pa rnams kyis tshul 'di la rab tu brtson par bya'o// ༈ /yul kha cig na khyim khrus zhes pa khyim du thab gtso bor gyur pa la khrus byed srol yod pa ltar na/ gzhan gong bzhin la/ sbyong ba'i skabs su/ gnas khang 'di'i phyi nang phug mdo bar gsum la 'grims pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad ces bsgyur/ khrus mgron dgug mi dgos/ me long thab sogs la bstan te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad dang*/ dug khrus/ 'byung khrus rnams la yig brgya dang*/ khrus sngags spel ba sngar bzhin/ bum chu 'thor zhing*/ gnas khang 'di nyid kyi phyi nang phug mdo bar gsum na gnyug mar gnas shing 'go ba'i lha dang*/ sa bdag klu gnyan la sogs pa rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sogs ri khrus kyi skabs bzhin tshang ma brjod pa'am/ shing gnyan bcad pa zhes sogs kyi tshig rkang gcig po dor yang rung*/ mthar/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ gang ser ma dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs sam/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis rgyas pa brjod cing*/ rten 'brel snying po/ rnam sras dang nor bu bzang po'i gzungs/

dpal chen mo'i mtshan gzungs/ gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i sngags sogs gang shes brjod pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad nor rgyun ma dang*/ dpal chen mo la sogs pa'i skur bzhengs te rin po che'i me tog gi char 'bebs par bsam zhing*/ dngos su rol mo dang bcas pas me tog gtor na/ rgyal ba'i bka' yang dag pa'i bden pas khyim der dge legs dang*/ dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa 'phel bar 'gyur nges pas 'di'ang gal che ba zhig go /bang mdzod kyi g.yang rten lta bu dang*/ ra ba sogs kyi klu sa bdag gi rten la sogs la khrus byed na'ang 'don bya 'di kho nas don 'grub bo// khyim khrus su grags pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo// ༈ /yang sems can rta phyugs kyi khyu'am 'brog pa'i lhas sam/ khrom chen po lta bu la spyi khrus byed na/ sbyong ba'i skabs su/ bsgrub bya 'di rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs zhes sgyur/ bsgrub bya rnams la me long bstan te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ phar phyin drug gi khrus dang*/ dug khrus/ 'byung khrus rnams la sngags spel ba ri khrus dang 'dra zhing*/ mthar bum chu 'thor zhing sngags mang du brjod/ bsgrub bya 'di rnams kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar tshe dpag med lha dgu'i cho ga ltar ram/ rnam 'joms bum chog bzhin brjod/ gang ser ram/ ston mchog dam pa sogs kyi bkra shis brjod do// 'di ni spyi khyab tu bde rim tsam bya ba'i tshul yin la/ mi phyugs la 'go ba'i yams nad yod skabs lta bu la/ ri khrod lo gyon ma'i bum chog dang 'brel ba'i yangs grong gi mdo gdon pa'i cho ga ngag dbang kun blo'i yig cha bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o// dgon sde dang grong spyir byad rbod zug pa lta bu la byad dkrol zlog sgrub bya ba ha cang mang ches pas cho ga ji lta ba bzhin mi lcogs na/

slob dpon gyi bya ba gdugs dkar/ gtsug 'bar/ srung ba lnga/ gser lde la sogs pa rang rang gi gzhung bzhin tshad ldan du bsgrub/ bsgrub bya rnams la dmigs pa'i bsgom lung legs par phog la/ khrus sogs gong bzhin me long gi ngos byas pas don 'grub bo// mi phyugs la spyi khrus ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa ste mdor na khrus kyi rim pa ma lus pa bstan zin to// gong smos phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad kyi tshig rkang dang po gnyis la mchog dman gyi dbye ba med kyang*/ rten khrus skabs tshig rkang gsum pa'i mthar/ rnam dbye gsum pa yod pa legs bsgos chus/ zhes dang*/ tshig rkang bzhi pa'i khongs su/ khrus legs mdzad la/ zhes rnam dbye gnyis pa yod pa dkyus su bkod pa ltar 'don dgos shing*/ ri khrus sogs dman khrus skabs tshig rkang gsum pa'i mthar rnam dbye med pa/ legs bsgos chu/ zhes pa dang*/ bzhi pa'i khongs su rnam dbye gsum pa yod pa/ khrus legs mdzad kyis/ zhes yod pa 'di bzhin tshig don gyi 'gal 'brel dpyod pa'i gzhung lugs chen po'i srol yin pas ngag rgyun 'khyal pa rgan rgon gyis sgrol ma 'don pa ltar mi bya zhing*/ rten khrus skabs dug khrus/ 'byung khrus rnams mi bya zhing*/ dman khrus skabs sku phye mi dgos pa sogs kyi dbye ba'ang shes par bya'o// zhes rten khrus ri khrus sogs kyi lag len nyes pa kun sel zhes pa 'di ni rang gzhan lag len pa rnams la mkho che bar mthong nas/ rgyal khams pa ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer ram/ tha snyad rig pa'i btags ming du 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i nyi ma tshangs sras dgyes pa'i lang tsho zhes 'bod pas sga ri thung thub bstan dar rgyas gling du bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun dri ma mtha' dag spangs pa'i ye shes chen por byang chub par gyur cig /sarba maṅga la bhū yā ta// ༈ /rnam thos sras kyi mtshan sngags ni/

oṃ bai shra ba ṇā ya swā hā/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drā ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ s+yād ya the dan/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu lu ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu lu tsu lu ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ sarba ar+thaṃ me sā dha ya swā ā/ tad+ya thā/ pū ta ne su pū ta ne/ su ru me/ su mā ti/ su rā the/ sa sme ba te/ hi li ke hi li kā li/ pūr+ṇe sid+dhe bha dra/ hi li hi li swā hā/ e hi so niṣ+ke e hi go niṣ+ke swā hā/ gnod 'dzin chu dbang gi gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra'i 'phror/ ku ru/ tu ru/ tsu ru/ su ru sogs/ e h+ye hi tiṣ+ṭha me sā dha ya swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ pū ta ne pū ta ne/ su ru me/ su mā te/ su ban+te su puṣ+ya/ hi li mi li swā hā/ dpal chen mo'i gzungs/ s+yād ya the dan/ dzi ni gh+ri ni/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ sha shi ni a lak+ṣ+mi ni/ me nā sha ya sid+dh+yan+tu man+tu ma ra pa dāḥswā hā/ oṃ bhṛ ku ṭī pa ra ma su bha ge swā hā/ nor rgyun ma'i snying po/ oṃ ba su dhā re swā hā/ oṃ ba su shrī ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su swā hā/ oṃ ba su swā hā/ tshogs bdag gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ na mo stu te ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ oṃ ga ga ga ga ga ga ga gaḥ oṃ na mo na maḥswā hā/ snang brgyad/ oṃ ā ka ni/ ni ka ni/ ā bī la/ man+dha le/ man+dha le swā hā/ maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/
